howto.name: Upload two PDFs
howto.text: The first is the baseline; the second is the revised version.

howto.name: Choose comparison mode
howto.text: Text: word-level diff. Visual: side-by-side rendered pages with changes highlighted.

howto.name: Download or view the diff
howto.text: PrivaTools returns a report PDF with additions in green and deletions in red, plus a summary of changed pages and word counts.

faq.q: Does this work on scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Only with OCR. Run OCR PDF on both files first so the text layer is present, then compare.

faq.q: How accurate is the text diff?
faq.a: Word-level diff handles reordering, insertion, deletion, and formatting changes. Diffs based on character runs would be noisier.

faq.q: Can I compare more than two files?
faq.a: Run Compare twice (A vs B, then B vs C) to chain a multi-revision comparison.
